name: Paste Pad
summary: A spiral sketch pad that takes a screenshot straight from Ctrl + V, tapes it down and pencils the upload
about: Paste Pad is an upload area built for screenshots. Press Ctrl + V (or the Paste button, or drop or choose a file) and the real picture from your clipboard falls onto the dotted page and two strips of tape stick it down, with its true size and pixel count underneath. Upload sends a little pencil along a hand-drawn wave as the progress bar, ticks it off with a doodle and files the picture into the Sent strip; pasted text becomes a sticky note instead.
how: Copy a picture (a screenshot works best), click the pad and press Ctrl + V, or use Paste, Choose or drag and drop.
Check the size and pixel count under the taped picture; pasting text makes a note instead.
Press Upload: the pencil draws the progress, a doodle ticks it off and the picture files itself under Sent.
Paste the next one; the Sent strip keeps the last six.
